32003.page_note: Las Vegas valley: LVMPD's 911 routing layer (effective 2024-09-01) assigns areas to AMR, Community Ambulance and MedicWest. The layer does not cover Henderson, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, Mesquite, Moapa Valley or Mount Charleston, so this county is not tier A. Henderson Fire and Boulder City Fire run their own ambulances and Mesquite Fire & Rescue runs a city ambulance (city websites, not area records). North Las Vegas: MedicWest says it covers the city (amr.net); no city record found. Moapa Valley transport role could not be verified.

outside_layer_sources.Henderson Fire Department: https://www.cityofhenderson.com (EMS page 403 to direct fetch; "eleven transport-capable advanced life support ambulance rescue units" and Review-Journal 2019 "more than 99 percent of 911 transports in Henderson are handled by city first responders", both from search summaries)
outside_layer_sources.Boulder City Fire Department: https://bcnv.org/856/BC-Cares-Ambulance-Membership ("there is no other ambulance service available in Boulder City", search summary)
outside_layer_sources.North Las Vegas: https://amr.net/locations/nevada/north-las-vegas (MedicWest self-reported "all of North Las Vegas"); city record not found
outside_layer_sources.Moapa Valley Fire District / Mount Charl: SNHD permit list names them as permitted agencies; transport role not verified

32003.decision: Held at C partial: the layer is a record for the valley only; Henderson, Boulder City and Mesquite rest on city websites seen via search summaries, North Las Vegas has no record. Dropped federal, air/IFT and private non-911 licences.
